title: Firewalls
intro: The core policy-routes each seat range to its firewalls. A range over several firewalls is cut into equal parts, one per firewall. Here you see where each part should go, where it goes now, and how the firewalls are.
none: No firewalls yet. Give the firewalls the role Firewall in the inventory, then plan their ranges here.
noRangesEdit: No ranges planned yet. Add each seat range the core routes, with its firewalls.
unread: The monitoring source can't be read right now: the ranges show their planned firewall.
moved_one: {{count}} part of a range is not on its planned firewall
moved_other: {{count}} parts of ranges are not on their planned firewall
name: Name
lineHelp: The firewalls the core routes this range to, in order. With several, each gets an equal part: four firewalls, a quarter each.
importHelp: Reads the NetBox prefixes that have the custom field floorbit_firewalls (their firewalls, in order: the prefix is cut into equal parts over them). Each import replaces the last; ranges planned here stay.
fromPluginHelp: Change it in {{plugin}} and import again.
noMonitoring: No monitoring source is set up, so the ranges show their planned firewall. An admin adds LibreNMS (or another monitoring plugin) under Settings.
switchesHelp: Optional. Seats behind these switches with an address outside their ranges show under Problems: a wrong port, a wrong VLAN or a router of their own. Left empty, each switch's range is the one most of its seats are in.
fallbackHelp: Optional. Only if the core moves a part while its own firewall is down, in this order. Left empty, the part is down with its firewall.
cutInto_other: Cut into {{count}} equal parts, one per firewall in this order.
inInventory: Groups, tags and notes in the inventory
